title: 300 soldiers vs 10,000 zombies: can one bridge hold?
author: BeautifulSkill5804
selftext: I wanted terrain in Zombie Siege to matter at a scale where the army is outnumbered more than 30 to 1. I used an AI coding assistant to build a repeatable scenario and verify matching army, deployment and ten-wave inputs. The open-ground run lost all 300 soldiers; the bridge run ended with 280 alive. AI also helped set up the continuous capture and align sound to game events. The enemy pathfinding and combat came from the game. Does the overhead shot make the choke obvious before the first wave reaches it?
